newsitem.title: USA: American TeleSource gets credit facility from IBM.
newsitem.headline: American TeleSource gets credit facility from IBM.

text.p: Privately held American TeleSource International Inc on Tuesday said that through its Mexican subsidiary ATSI Mexico SA de CV, a $1.725 million credit facility has been secured with International Business Machines Corp's Mexican unit.
ATSI said the credit facility will assist the company in the purchase of U.S.-standard intelligent pay telephones for installation in Mexico.
Intelligent pay phones are capable of accepting credit cards calling card an coins, the firm said.
The compamny said it plans to install 11,000 pay phones over the next five years.
